freeze_semantics: Content-hash freeze of the codex adapter's output over the conformance scenario at harness 0.114.0. codex uses the preprocess path: preprocess_codex.py normalises the native rollout session log (~/.codex/sessions/rollout-*.jsonl) into one container, which codex.dsl.yaml turns into one trace. The same adapter also reads the thin `codex exec --json` stdout format via field-presence dispatch, but this rung freezes the rich rollout format. verify.py re-runs preprocess+DSL on each input (cwd = this dir, input paths relative) and asserts trace_count, per-trace content_hash, and unmapped_path_count. codex traces carry no provenance.source_path, so the content_hash is checkout-independent (the input path does not enter the hash). First codex rung and the older end of codex's first release-delta baseline; the candidate is a fresh 0.143.0 capture.
